biotools.summary: ViralPrimer is a web server designed to monitor viral nucleic acid amplification tests' primer efficiency, particularly during pandemics like those caused by SARS-CoV-2 and Mpox. It facilitates primer design, variant monitoring, and user primer upload, contributing to diagnostic accuracy and broader public health protection.
